source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (register of licensed financial institutions, PDF series)
why_relevant: Legally mandated enumeration of every licensed bank, microfinance institution, non-bank financial institution, payment institution, e-money institution, insurer and pension fund in Kosovo. This is the closest thing to a complete buyer universe for banking/payments vendors in XK, and it is periodically re-issued as a dated PDF, so successive versions give entry/exit signal.

source_name: BQK — Sistemet e pagesave (Payment Systems section, main hub)
why_relevant: Top-level hub for national payment infrastructure: KIPS interbank system, its operating scheme, payment system oversight, and payment statistics. The pointer that leads to the specific pages naming the switch/RTGS/instant-payment components and their participants.

source_name: BQK — Skema e funksionimit të Sistemit Ndërbankar të Pagesave (KIPS operating scheme)
why_relevant: Describes the architecture of KIPS and enumerates its direct participants (reported as 14 direct participants: 11 commercial banks, the CBK itself, Treasury/MF, and KPST). Direct read on who is connected to the national rails — i.e. the accounts a payments vendor must integrate with.

source_name: BQK — Mbikëqyrja e Sistemit të Pagesave (payment system oversight)
why_relevant: Oversight page setting out CBK's statutory oversight of payment systems and instruments; typically names overseen systems/schemes and the criteria applied. Useful for identifying which schemes and operators are formally recognised in Kosovo.

source_name: BQK — Tenderët (CBK tender announcements)
why_relevant: The CBK is itself a procurer of IT systems, cash-handling and currency-processing equipment, ATM/branch infrastructure and services. Its own tender and contract-award notices name incumbent vendors and contract values — direct competitive intelligence for a payments-technology supplier.

source_name: BQK — Planifikimi vjetor i prokurimeve në BQK (CBK annual procurement plan)
why_relevant: Forward-looking: the annual procurement plan signals IT, security, cash-handling and payment-infrastructure purchases before the tender is published. Highest-value early-warning source for a vendor selling to the central bank.

source_name: BQK — Publikimet (publications hub: Annual Report, Financial Stability Report, Macroeconomic Developments, Monthly Financial System Information)
why_relevant: Master index of CBK periodicals. The Annual Report contains a dedicated payment-system chapter (KIPS volumes/values, card and terminal counts, SEPA and instant-payment project status); the Financial Stability Report profiles the banking sector's structure and digital-channel adoption. Both name infrastructure projects and their partners.

source_name: BQK — Godišnji Izveštaj / CBK Annual Report PDF series (Serbian and Albanian editions)
why_relevant: The full-text annual reports, back to at least 2017, are directly downloadable. They carry the payment-system chapter year by year — the single best time series on KIPS transaction volumes/values, card and terminal estate, and named modernisation projects. Serbian editions confirm sr-language coverage of the same content.

source_name: BQK — Statistikat / Seritë kohore (statistics and time series)
why_relevant: Machine-friendly time series on the financial and external sector, including payment-system indicators (cards issued, ATM and POS terminal counts, transaction volumes). Quantifies terminal-estate and acceptance-network growth — the direct addressable market for POS/ATM hardware and acquiring software.

source_name: BQK — Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë (card usage report)
why_relevant: A dedicated CBK report on card usage in Kosovo, with card-scheme, ATM/POS and transaction breakdowns. Directly sizes the card-acceptance market and its growth rate (e.g. domestic POS card payments reported growing ~30.7% in 2023).

source_name: BQK — Korniza ligjore / Rregulloret (regulations repository, incl. payments and crypto-assets)
why_relevant: Regulations define who may be licensed, what technical obligations apply, and which new market segments are opening. Recent items are strongly vendor-relevant: access of non-bank PSPs to payment systems (Dec 2025), the interbank payment system regulation (Nov 2025), electronic payment instruments, transfer-of-funds information, and the crypto-asset service operator licensing regulation in force 29 Nov 2025.

source_name: Ligji Nr. 04/L-155 për Sistemin e Pagesave (Law on the Payment System)
why_relevant: The statute that creates the CBK's publication and oversight duties for payment systems, defines participant categories and licensing obligations. Establishes what must legally exist as a public register — the backbone assumption of this whole coverage cell.

source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette) — GZK
why_relevant: Authoritative publisher of the CBK Law (Nr. 03/L-209), the Payment System Law, the Crypto-Assets Law and all amendments, in sq/sr/en. Useful as the legally canonical text and as an early signal when a new financial-sector law is promulgated — every such law reshapes the licensed-institution universe.

source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo national e-procurement platform (KRPP)
why_relevant: Mandatory national platform where the CBK — and every other public contracting authority — publishes contract notices, contract-award notices and annual procurement plans. Handles ~10,000 procedures a year. Cross-check and superset for CBK's own tenders page, and the way to catch CBK IT/payments awards that the CBK site indexes poorly.

source_name: BQK — Shpalljet (announcements hub: tenders, vacancies, notices)
why_relevant: Parent section holding tenders and procurement plans; also job vacancies, which are an indirect signal of which systems and technologies the CBK is building (e.g. hiring for instant payments, SEPA, core-system administration).

source_name: BQK — Regjistri i kredive / Kredimarrësit (Credit Registry of Kosovo, CRK)
why_relevant: The CBK operates the national Credit Registry — a CBK-run IT system with reporting institutions. Relevant as (a) a list of reporting/participating financial institutions and (b) a CBK-operated platform that is itself periodically procured, upgraded and integrated, i.e. a vendor opportunity and a named-project source.

source_name: BQK — Serbian-language mirror of the site (?lang=sr, /platni-sistem/)
why_relevant: The CBK publishes in Albanian, Serbian and English on the same CMS via a ?lang= switch and Serbian slugs. Confirms sr-language collectability of registers, regulations and annual reports, and is the route to Serbian-language terminology used by North-Kosovo market actors.

source_name: BQK — Financial Statements (audited CBK accounts)
why_relevant: Audited CBK financial statements disclose capital expenditure on intangible assets and equipment — a coarse but hard indicator of the CBK's own IT and infrastructure investment cycle, useful for sizing the central bank as a buyer.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës / Kosovo Banking Association — Komiteti i Pagesave (Payments Committee)
why_relevant: Industry-side counterpart to the CBK on payment-system projects. Its Payments Committee and news items track the banking sector's move to instant payments and SEPA alongside the CBK, and name participating banks — a snowball route from the regulator to the actual buyer institutions and their project timing.

source_name: Banca d'Italia / Western Balkans TIPS-clone instant payment programme coverage (incl. ECB MIP news, World Bank, German Economic Team)
why_relevant: Kosovo's instant-payment rail is being supplied as a TIPS-based clone by Banca d'Italia under a multi-country Western Balkans agreement (with Albania, BiH, Montenegro), and Kosovo submitted a preliminary SEPA application. This external, non-CBK reporting names the actual technology supplier and the go-live timing that CBK material states only obliquely — the key partnership/vendor fact for this cell.

source_name: Kosovo financial/economic trade press as CBK-announcement amplifier (Telegrafi, Buletini Ekonomik, KosovaPress, Kallxo)
why_relevant: CBK press releases, new regulations, licensing decisions and report launches are amplified in Albanian trade media, often faster and more searchably than on the CBK's own bot-defended site. Practical low-latency trigger to go fetch the primary CBK document, and sometimes the only searchable record of a licensing decision.

source_name: Vokshi & Lata and peer Kosovo law-firm regulatory briefings on CBK licensing
why_relevant: Local law firms publish practical decodes of CBK licensing regimes with deadlines and applicant obligations. They surface which categories of operator are about to be licensed (and therefore about to buy compliance/payments technology) earlier and more legibly than the regulation text.

source_name: Kosovo PPRC/KRPP OCDS bulk data publication (OCP Data Registry entry)
why_relevant: KRPP publishes Kosovo procurement in Open Contracting Data Standard via API, covering the full cycle: plans, tender, bidders, buyer, supplier, method, tender and contract value. This is the machine-readable route to a complete vendor-award timeline for payment/banking IT, avoiding HTML scraping entirely. Registry entry documents known quality issues (null fields, 'award' vs 'awards' array typo).

source_name: KRPP — Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik (Public Procurement Regulatory Commission)
why_relevant: Regulator and operator of e-Prokurimi. Publishes standard notice forms, annual public-procurement reports (aggregate spend by authority and by contract type), legislation, and news. Its annual reports are the fastest way to size the state IT/payments procurement wallet and identify the largest contracting authorities to then drill into.

source_name: OSHP — Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit (Procurement Review Body), decisions and complaints registry
why_relevant: Binding complaint decisions name the complainant and the winning bidder, and often disclose technical specification disputes, evaluation scores and pricing — richer competitive detail than the award notice itself. Has a searchable procurement-activity search, complaint tables by year (2013-2026) and a blacklist of economic operators. Ideal for mapping which integrators fight over bank/payment IT lots in Kosovo.

source_name: OSHP archive site (arkivaoshp.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: Holds the legacy corpus of OSHP decisions that the current portal may not expose, giving deeper historical continuity on vendor disputes for payment/banking IT tenders.

source_name: AQP — Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit (Central Procurement Agency)
why_relevant: Runs centralised/framework procurement on behalf of many Kosovo state bodies. Framework contracts for IT, cards, printing and services signed here bind multiple ministries at once, so a single AQP award can determine a vendor's access to the whole public sector.

source_name: Open Procurement Transparency Portal — prokurimihapur.org (Levizja FOL)
why_relevant: Independent, cleaned mirror of Kosovo public contracts awarded since 2010, with filtering by authority and company. Very useful as a cross-check and for pre-2016 history that predates e-Prokurimi, letting you build a long vendor time series for payment/banking IT.
